InventoryGLConfig.title: Inventory GL Posting Configuration
InventoryGLConfig.description: Per-administration mapping from inventory stock-movement event types (sale dispatch, goods receipt, count variance) to General Ledger account numbers. One active record per administrationId. Drives the declarative posting lifecycle on InventoryValuation. Holds FK account numbers (cogsAccountNumber, inventoryAssetAccountNumber, grIrClearingAccountNumber, inventoryAdjustmentAccountNumber) that MUST resolve to existing Account records in the same administration (FK invariant). When isActive=false or any account is missing, the lifecycle action skips the GLTransaction materialisation and emits a structured warning event: no zero-cost or unmatched GL entries are written. Schema.org Thing.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: InventoryGLConfig changes (account number remapping, isActive toggle) MUST be audit-trail-immutable / ADR-022: every change to a GL account routing is bookkeeping-relevant: it changes where future COGS / inventory-asset / count-variance postings land and is subject to operator + auditor review.

administrationId.description: FK to Administration owning this posting configuration (multi-administratie scope). One active config per administrationId.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

cogsAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber: debited on sale/dispatch event (Dr COGS). Default RGS 3.5 MKB '7000' Kostprijs omzet. MUST resolve to an existing Account in the same administration (FK invariant).
cogsAccountNumber.title: COGS Account Number

inventoryAssetAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber: debited on goods receipt (Dr Inventory Asset) and credited on COGS posting / negative variance. Default RGS 3.5 MKB '1400' Voorraden. MUST resolve to an existing Account in the same administration.
inventoryAssetAccountNumber.title: Inventory Asset Account Number

grIrClearingAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber: credited on goods receipt (Cr GR/IR clearing); subsequently debited by AP invoice posting. Default RGS 3.5 MKB '1800' GR/IR clearing. MUST resolve to an existing Account in the same administration. Two-step pattern avoids double-posting.
grIrClearingAccountNumber.title: Gr Ir Clearing Account Number

inventoryAdjustmentAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber: debited on negative count variance / credited on positive count variance. Default RGS 3.5 MKB '7100' Voorraadmutaties. MUST resolve to an existing Account in the same administration.
inventoryAdjustmentAccountNumber.title: Inventory Adjustment Account Number

isActive.description: Whether perpetual inventory GL posting is enabled for this administration. When false, the InventoryValuation lifecycle action skips materialisation and logs a 'posting_disabled' structured warning (skip scenario).
isActive.title: Is Active

description.description: Operator notes: e.g. 'NL RGS 3.5 MKB defaults applied' or 'overridden to match parent corporate chart'.
description.title: Description

glTransactionId.description: Back-reference to a GLTransaction.id booked for this valuation, where one exists. Sale dispatch COGS is booked per stock move by CogsPosterService and referenced from the move.
glTransactionId.title: GL Transaction ID

postingEvent.description: The stock-movement event behind the valuation's most recent change. Informational: sale dispatch is booked per stock move by CogsPosterService (StockMove.post), not by a transition on this snapshot; goods receipt and count variance are not booked to the ledger yet.
postingEvent.title: Posting Event

subLedgerType.description: Sub-ledger discriminator. T2 owns the actual sub-ledger registers. 'inventory' added by inventory-cogs-posting + extension (list-concat with base enum); subLedgerRef points to the InventoryValuation UUID that triggered the lifecycle posting (saleDispatch / goodsReceipt / countVariance).
subLedgerType.title: Sub Ledger Type
